response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT P.SEX AS sex, AVG(CAST(L.CPK AS REAL) / L.GPT) AS avg_ratio FROM Laboratory L JOIN Patient P ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE P.SEX IS NOT NULL AND P.SEX <> '' AND L.CPK IS NOT NULL AND L.GPT IS NOT NULL AND L.GPT <> 0 GROUP BY P.SEX), m1 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean1 FROM g), k AS (SELECT g.sex, g.avg_ratio FROM g, m1 WHERE g.avg_ratio > m1.mean1), m2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean2 FROM k), r AS (SELECT k.avg_ratio FROM k, m2 WHERE k.avg_ratio > m2.mean2) SELECT AVG(r.avg_ratio) AS avg_of_remaining, AVG(r.avg_ratio - (SELECT mean1 FROM m1)) AS avg_excess_over_mean1, AVG(r.avg_ratio - (SELECT mean2 FROM m2)) AS avg_excess_over_mean2 FROM r
